summary: Assay worksheet for MV-2006-090, the NM08 paired liver systems study for Nimbravelle Medicines Inc: 24 aminotriazine analogues run in microsomal and cryopreserved hepatocyte CLint, with the accession-lot mapping and matrix acceptance checks. Microsomal and hepatocyte rankings agree for most of the set; the analogues Nimbravelle advanced are the ones with slower hepatocyte turnover that also rank well in microsomes.

rows.v: Liver microsomal stability (house name: Microsomal CLint)

rows: 0.5 mg/mL protein, 1 µM test article, NADPH regenerating system. Clearance in µL/min/mg; half-life from the log-linear slope. Species: human and rat.

sheets.name: Hepatocyte CLint

rows.v: Cryopreserved hepatocyte stability (house name: Hepatocyte depletion CLint)

rows: 1 µM test article, 0.5 x 10^6 cells/ml, 37 °C, sampling to 120 min. Units µL/min/10^6 cells. Human and rat assay columns are distinct; species-specific matrix lot references remain in the accession analyte cards, not inferred from the number of columns.
